evidence_nodes.report:
# PCAP evidence summary

Decoded 22828 packets across 364 IP endpoints and 1475 transport flows. Observed 2822 DNS events, 234 HTTP requests, 182 TLS ClientHello events, and 191 recovered file/message object(s). Deterministic rules produced 68 finding(s): 0 high, 60 medium, and 8 low. Findings are evidence-bound candidates and require analyst review; encrypted payload contents remain unavailable.

Full packet evidence: /api/pcap/analyses/76f521c2-4e4a-41d5-95ad-a44fd9887dd8

Write the concise investigation summary after enrichment.
